## Residential House Cleaning & Maid Services (5 Programs)
- [House Cleaning & Maid Service Hub](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/house-cleaning/)
- [Standard House Cleaning](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/house-cleaning/standard-cleaning/): Dependable kitchen, bathroom, bedroom, and floor cleaning for busy Rocklin, Roseville, and Granite Bay homes.
- [Deep House Cleaning](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/house-cleaning/deep-cleaning/): Top-to-bottom hand-wiped baseboards, cabinet fronts, door frames, light fixtures, and heavy bathroom/kitchen detailing.
- [Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/house-cleaning/move-out-cleaning/): Empty-home turnover cleaning inside cabinets, drawers, closets, appliances, and baseboards for maximum deposit return or listing photos.
- [Recurring House Cleaning (Weekly / Biweekly / Monthly)](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/house-cleaning/recurring-cleaning/): Save 10% to 20% per visit with a locked-in recurring day, consistent crew, and zero contracts.
- [Vacation Rental & Executive Housing Turnover](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/house-cleaning/vacation-rental-cleaning/): Same-day 11 AM–3 PM guest turnovers, linen resets, restock checks, and damage photo reporting for Airbnb/VRBO and corporate rentals.

## Commercial Cleaning & Janitorial Services (11 Facility Types)
- [Commercial Cleaning Hub](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/commercial-cleaning/)
- [Offices & Corporate Suites](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/commercial-cleaning/office/): Multi-desk workspaces, executive suites, and conference rooms cleaned after hours without touching a single document.
- [Medical Offices & Outpatient Clinics](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/commercial-cleaning/medical-office/): Exam rooms, waiting areas, and nurses' stations disinfected with EPA List N hospital-grade virucides and full contact-time verification.
- [Dental Practices & Orthodontic Clinics](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/commercial-cleaning/dental-office/): Operatory floors, chair bases, sterilization zones, and reception lounges detailed for patients staring at the ceiling for 45 minutes.
- [Daycares, Preschools & Childcare Centers](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/commercial-cleaning/daycare-preschool/): Child-safe, fragrance-free sanitization from floor level to 48 inches—built for California Community Care Licensing inspections.
- [Multi-Tenant Office & Flex Buildings](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/commercial-cleaning/property-management/): Common lobbies, elevators, shared corridor restrooms, and stairwells maintained across multi-building portfolios with monthly QA reporting.
- [Post-Construction & Tenant Improvement (TI) Projects](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/commercial-cleaning/post-construction/): Rough, final, and punch-list touch-up cleans for general contractors on tight C-of-O and owner-walkthrough deadlines.
- [Banks, Credit Unions & Wealth Management Branches](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/commercial-cleaning/bank-credit-union/): Vetted, background-checked after-hours teams trained for alarm zones, teller lines, ATM vestibules, and vault-adjacent security rules.
- [Gyms, Pilates/Yoga Studios & Athletic Clubs](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/commercial-cleaning/gym-fitness/): Locker rooms, rubber floor zones, mirrors, and sweat-contact surfaces disinfected against MRSA, ringworm, and odor bacteria.
- [Churches, Sanctuaries & Faith Campuses](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/commercial-cleaning/church/): Sanctuaries, fellowship halls, nurseries, and high-traffic restrooms reset after Sunday services and mid-week programs.
- [Retail Stores, Auto/Design Showrooms & Boutiques](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/commercial-cleaning/retail-showroom/): Streak-free storefront glass, polished showroom floors, and spotless fitting/client restrooms that protect average ticket value.
- [Distribution Offices, Light Manufacturing & Flex Facilities](https://debrasclassiccleaning.com/commercial-cleaning/warehouse-industrial/): Heavy-use locker rooms, driver breakrooms, and attached administrative offices kept clean despite forklift dust and boot traffic.
